description: The document's named character and paragraph styles. Text layers keep fully resolved attributes in their runs; a run names the style it was made from by id.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's shape. Always 1 in raster-layers/1.

basic.description: The basic paragraph style (id 0). Empty attribute sets mean the defaults.

char_attrs.description: The character attributes this style sets: a subset of the keys of a character style (`font_family`, `size_pt`, `color`, ...).

id.description: Stable id; 0 is the basic paragraph style.

para_attrs.description: The paragraph attributes this style sets: a subset of the keys of a paragraph style (`align`, `first_line_indent_pt`, ...), with values of the same form as in a `core.raster.layer` text paragraph.

attrs.description: The character attributes this style sets: a subset of the keys of a character style.

char_attrs.description: The character attributes this style sets: a subset of the keys of a character style (`font_family`, `size_pt`, `color`, ...).

id.description: Stable id; 0 is the basic paragraph style.

para_attrs.description: The paragraph attributes this style sets: a subset of the keys of a paragraph style (`align`, `first_line_indent_pt`, ...), with values of the same form as in a `core.raster.layer` text paragraph.

psd_raw.description: The style sheets of the PSD text engine this document was read from, as JSON, kept so data PhotoCraft does not map survives. Opaque; null when there is none.
